verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents OAuth 2.0 so apps can act on a user's behalf, and it lets you invite AI agents into the workspace. Neither item shows a way to issue scoped, least-privilege, or permission-limited API credentials for an agent. Client mode controls what human clients see per project, which is an adjacent feature, not credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
